static.mechanism: The unpromoted D1 state conservatively retained the verified D0 Python 3.10 program, which matched the D2 return condition.

mechanism_findings: The static and adaptive D1 Agents independently generated target-Python-parameterized programs for mpmath and reproject, so both arms replayed D2 without a model call.
The fontbakery static D1 candidate was not harness-qualified, so the state machine retained the verified D0 program. Because D2 returned to the D0 condition, static again passed without a model call.
The D0-to-D1-to-D0 sequence therefore cannot establish that historical regression is needed: parameterized D1 programs pass D2, while conservative rejection of D1 also restores the D0 program for D2.

Adaptive historical replays increased package-download exposure. Two adaptive D2 attempts were infrastructure-censored, and the completed fontbakery adaptive D2 could not retain its candidate because one historical replay was infrastructure-censored even though Official passed.

scientific_assessment.main_contradiction: The feasibility pilot suggested that a cross-episode compatibility frontier saves strong-Agent fallback calls, but outcome-blind replication shows that the equally capable static Agent usually writes a reusable parameterized installer itself, while a D0-to-D1-to-D0 sequence also lets conservative static rollback pass D2.
scientific_assessment.strongest_supporting_evidence: All three adaptive D2 runs replayed successfully without an Agent and Official-passed, demonstrating that one executable installer can survive the tested condition reversal.
scientific_assessment.strongest_counterevidence_or_alternative: Static also achieved 3/3 D2 Official Pass with zero Agent calls. Adaptive added 1534.12 seconds of historical replay in completed endpoints, took 2.26 times the static endpoint lifecycle, and created additional infrastructure failure opportunities.
scientific_assessment.decision_basis: The preregistered kill condition was met: adaptive had no D2 fallback advantage on all three projects while adding historical replay cost. It also failed to retain the fontbakery D2 candidate after an infrastructure-censored historical replay despite an Official pass.
scientific_assessment.scope_of_kill: Kill cross-episode monotonic compatibility-frontier maintenance as the EnvSolve-Pro core. Retain the runner and trajectories only as a diagnostic or negative ablation.
scientific_assessment.next_highest_information_experiment: From consumed/Dev trajectories, freeze cases where a fair strong free-Agent baseline produced a complete final program but failed only when that complete program was executed in a clean target environment. Compare the same model and interface with versus without target-state complete-program replay returned to the same still-active Agent session. Exclude failures that occur before a complete candidate exists and infrastructure-censored episodes.
